title: Serve-path latency sliceboard: per-model/route percentiles + io-mode split
creator: Ava Patel
description: Build a consolidated 'serve-path sliceboard' that surfaces p50/p95/p99 latency broken down by model and route, with an explicit split for IO mode (streaming vs non-streaming). This board must link traces, surface request-shape buckets, and be usable by SRE/Platform, runtime, and product teams for incident investigation and performance tuning. Work covers: adding tracing hooks at request routing and enqueue/dequeue boundaries, extending metrics/log schemas with io_mode and request_shape fields, updating OTel/collector pipeline and Datadog/Grafana dashboards, and defining alerting thresholds for percentile regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 per (model, route) and allows toggling streaming vs non-streaming view
Percentiles computed from production request histograms (no sampling distortions for top 1%); traces linkable to individual percentile buckets
New span attributes populated: route_id, model_name, model_version, io_mode (streaming|sync), request_shape (tokens_in|tokens_out|conv_turns)
OTel collector config updated and validated end-to-end; new metrics and logs appear in observability backend within 90s
Deck includes cohorted time-series (last 1h/24h/7d) and ability to filter by release, region, and customer tier
Automated alerting rule created: p95 increase >25% vs baseline for >= 10min triggers P1 page
Dashboard documentation and runbook added (links to PRs and playbook)
progress_updates: 2026-02-22: Kickoff with Runtime and Observability teams. Agreed on io_mode enum and request_shape buckets. (Ava, Diego)
2026-02-25: Prototype span hook added at router enqueue; initial attrs emitted to staging (PR #5482). Observability confirms receipt in Honeycomb staging.
2026-03-01: OTel collector update prepared to add 'io_mode' and 'request_shape' as indexed labels in Datadog; discussed cardinality implications and decided to use coarse buckets for request_shape.
2026-03-05: First draft Grafana panel created (panel id draft-serve-slice) showing p50/p95/p99 computed from histogram metrics. Spike observed in p95 for model-x-route-a in staging.
2026-03-09: Infra requested change to limit cardinality for model_version labels; agreed to roll up to model_name for high-volume routes and keep model_version for explicit filter only.
2026-03-10: Began canary rollout of tracing hooks to 10% of production traffic; telemetry validated. Next: finish dashboard filters and create alert rule PR.
decisions: Use coarse request_shape buckets (e.g., tiny, small, medium, large) instead of raw token counts to avoid high cardinality and metric explosion.
Emit io_mode as explicit span attribute (values: streaming, sync) and expose as metric label for percentile aggregation.
Percentiles will be computed from OpenMetrics histograms emitted by the runtime; fallback to sampled p99 from traces only for low-volume routes.
Model version will be rolled up to model_name in default dashboard views; a secondary selector allows drilling into version when needed.
